check: every status change uses an allowed transition with its catalogued transition id and trigger event
each lead's history starts NEW (LEAD_CAPTURED) and chains without gaps
current lead status equals the latest status-history row
terminal statuses carry a disposition that applies to them; non-terminal statuses carry none
audited reopenings carry approver role and reason, within 180 days of closure; no other row has an approver
validation failures, releases to queue and reopenings record a status reason
surviving_lead_id is present exactly for merged leads
at most one active primary assignment per lead; exactly one RM owner for leads in active work
terminal leads have no active assignment
assignment status, active flag and lifecycle timestamps are consistent
manual overrides have a reason code and actor role; capacity exceptions only with an override
reassignments preserve the prior assignment and prior RM; prior assignments are ended as REASSIGNED or DECLINED
assignments preserve their routing decision and routing rule version
routing decisions: status at decision, rule traces from the routing catalog, queue and manual-review fields consistent
market scenario is recorded only for leads with full market evidence
duplicates: tiers match their rules; only exact and high-confidence groups auto-merge; review groups merge only when confirmed; survivor is the earlier matched lead
source attribution: each lead keeps its original touch; merged leads' touches move to the survivor unchanged; one first touch per surviving lead
every lead carries the default priority band P2 (A-009; no priority model exists)
language is used in routing only when explicitly stated
